method: Reloaded playback.html after the final export and visually inspected the refreshed original-speed and half-speed previews.
Reviewed the current contact sheet and stepped frames 6, 7, and 8 in the browser; the atlas is an 8-frame loop with frame 8 wrapping to frame 1.
observations: Both legs and shoes remain distinguishable across the two half-cycles; the supporting leg changes between the near and far leg.
The waist/hip junction has a small soft overlap consistent with the accepted cutout-paper-puppet approach; no open background gap is apparent in the refreshed previews at review scale.
At the loop boundary, the stance changes but the figure remains in the same left-facing silhouette and scale; no abrupt body jump was apparent.
The atlas report confirms RGBA output with zero transparent RGB residue pixels and no chroma fringe pixels.
limitations: This review validates the browser candidate only. It does not confirm that the native desktop pet panel has reloaded or installed the candidate.
The accepted source artwork is a cutout puppet; unseen surfaces were not reconstructed.
